description: Bookshop mission fixtures v2 (Slice 5). Weights are inspectable integer weights per consequence key; transitions are symbolic rules of the form '<REASON_CODE> -> <EVENT_TYPE> <consequence_key>' resolved by the pure reducer. STALE_BEYOND_RULE records a backlog item and opens no incident (matching the Slice 2/4 thin path); INVENTED_FACT and MISSING_EVIDENCE open incidents; MALFORMED_RESPONSE records a backlog item. All consequences are synthetic scenario state, not real revenue or customer trust.
